canonical_statement: Let (M,g) be a complete n-dimensional Riemannian manifold with n > 0 and nonnegative Ricci curvature. Let T > 0 and let u be a positive smooth solution of partial_t u = Delta_g u on M x (0,T]. Then for every x in M and 0 < t <= T, |grad_g u(x,t)|^2 / u(x,t)^2 - partial_t u(x,t) / u(x,t) <= n / (2t).
domain_and_universes: Provisional: a positive-dimensional complete finite-dimensional real Riemannian manifold M, T : Real, u : M -> Real -> Real; exact Lean universe, manifold model, metric, connection, Ricci tensor, and Laplacian APIs remain open.
quantifiers: n : Nat with 0 < n and dim(M) = n
x : M and t : Real with 0 < t and t <= T
hypotheses: Ric_g(v,v) >= 0 for every tangent vector v
u has the spatial and temporal smoothness required by the pointwise calculation
partial_t u = Delta_g u on M x (0,T]
conclusion: norm(grad_g u(x,t))^2 / u(x,t)^2 - partial_t u(x,t) / u(x,t) <= (n : Real) / (2 * t)
